name: TEMPERATURE CYCLING CHAMBER
desc: Smart Programmable Hot and Cold Temperature Cycling Chamber engineered for rapid thermal ramp testing and environmental stress screening of electronics. Features a 216-liter SS304 workspace delivering temperatures from -70°C up to 180°C with dynamic cycling ramp rates.
features: Extended deep-freeze and high-heat ranges from minus 70 to 180°C
High-efficiency rapid thermal transition tracking from 10 to 15°C per minute
Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) based advanced climate system module
Integrated multi-layer Heated Frost-Free Glass Observation Window
High-reliability low-vibration premium EMERSON brand compressor assembly

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance PLC-Controlled Environmental Temperature Cycling Chamber
specifications.Primary Process Function: Rapid hot and cold temperature cycling for stress testing of electronic profiles
specifications.Volumetric Chamber Capacity: 216 Litre intermediate standard high-running laboratory processing envelope
specifications.Chamber Internal Dimensions: Square-optimized internal clearance measuring exactly 600 × 600 × 600 mm (WxDxH)
specifications.Thermal Operating Spectrum: Extended deep-freeze and high-heat ranges from minus 70 to 180 degrees C
specifications.Dynamic Cycling Ramp Rate: High-efficiency rapid thermal transition tracking from 10 to 15 degrees C per minute
specifications.Primary System Automation: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) based advanced climate system module
specifications.Interface Display Terminal: High-resolution interactive industrial Color Touchscreen HMI panel dashboard
specifications.Concurrent Parameter Tracking: High-visibility live tracking displaying Set Value (SV) and Process Value (PV) matrices
specifications.Data Diagnostics Engine: In-built real-time continuous data logging with live operational Trend Graph displays
specifications.External Connectivity Link: Integrated USB interface supporting direct parameter data transfer to pen drives
specifications.Inner Chamber Construction: High-Grade Corrosion-Proof mirror-polished Stainless Steel (SS304 Grade) sheets
specifications.Outer Chassis Fabrication: Heavy-duty rugged Galvanized Iron (GI) steel sheets with protective powder coat
specifications.Thermal Insulation Core: High-density Polyurethane Foam (PUF) insulation blanket preventing thermal leakages
specifications.Access Door Security Assembly: Insulated heavy-duty single door with structural clamp latch and silicone sealing gaskets
specifications.Chamber Inspection Interface: Integrated multi-layer Heated Frost-Free Glass Observation Window for sample tracking
specifications.Thermal Generation Element: Premium industrial-grade long-life Stainless Steel (SS) tubular air heaters
specifications.Mechanical Cooling Engine: Fully integrated industrial CFC-free hermetically sealed cooling compressor network
specifications.Refrigeration Compressor Unit: High-reliability low-vibration premium EMERSON brand compressor assembly
specifications.Forced Air Convection Loop: Continuous uniform airflow vectoring driven by an internal motor-driven blower system
specifications.Sample Storage Infrastructure: Supplied complete with high-load Stainless Steel wire mesh adjustable cable trays
specifications.Primary Feedback Sensor: Industrial-grade integrated high-precision PT100 RTD thermal tracking sensor
specifications.Integrated Failsafe Protections: Temperature variation alarms, over-temperature protection, and compressor delay timers
specifications.Electrical Power Options: Available in standard 220 Volts Single Phase or 440 Volts Three Phase 50Hz links
specifications.Mobility Infrastructure Deck: Heavy-duty industrial rolling Caster Wheels providing smooth cabinet relocation layouts
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on core PLC logic and compressor
